transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, your Battalion S-6. Before I publish the binding network access plan for tomorrow, I need to confirm service requirements from each of you. We have three protected network segments — Red, Blue, and Green — and three service windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Each of the three services — the command video brief, the logistics synchronization feed, and the clinic records system — will be assigned one segment and one window. Please let me know your requirements so we can get configurations documented before each access window begins.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the command video brief. I received confirmation this morning that the partner headquarters bridge is configured only for Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window. This isn't on the change-control board slide yet, but the command video brief must use Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the logistics synchronization feed. I confirmed with the depot technician today that the legacy terminal accepts only the Blue segment profile, and the depot upload begins at 1000. So the logistics synchronization feed must use Segment Blue and the 1000-1100 window. This hasn't been added to the network request yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the clinic records system. I received the clinic server's isolation certificate record from the clinic administrator this morning — it's valid only on Segment Red, and the morning patient-file reconciliation starts at 0800. So the clinic records system must use Segment Red and the 0800-0900 window. This hasn't been entered in the access worksheet yet.
transcript.speaker: A4
